        answer = 0
        for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1), (-1, -1), (-1, 1)):
            tr, tc = dc, -dr
            turn_step = tr * width + tc
            suffix = [0] * size
            rows = range(n, 0, -1) if tr == 1 else range(1, n + 1)
            cols = range(m, 0, -1) if tc == 1 else range(1, m + 1)
            for r in rows:
                base = r * width
                for c in cols:
                    i = base + c
                    v = values[i]
                    expected = 2 if v == 1 else 2 - v
                    j = i + turn_step
                    suffix[i] = 1 + suffix[j] if values[j] == expected else 1
            prefix = [0] * size
            step = dr * width + dc
            rows = range(1, n + 1) if dr == 1 else range(n, 0, -1)
            cols = range(1, m + 1) if dc == 1 else range(m, 0, -1)
            for r in rows:
                base = r * width
                for c in cols:
                    i = base + c
                    v = values[i]

                        j = i - step
                        if not prefix[j]:

                        expected = 2 if values[j] == 1 else 2 - values[j]
                        if v != expected:
